name: Yardi Breeze
description: Yardi Breeze is cloud property-management software for residential, commercial, affordable, self-storage, association, and manufactured-housing portfolios, with built-in accounting, leasing, payments, maintenance, communications, and reporting.
best_for: Small and midsize property managers that want cloud property management with built-in accounting and published per-unit pricing.
features: Vacancy, prospect, marketing, and leasing workflows
Online applications, payments, maintenance requests, and resident tools
Owner and vendor payments and reporting
Cloud access from supported browsers with automatic updates

pricing.starting_price: $1/unit/month for residential Breeze; $100/month minimum; annual agreement

tiers.name: Residential Breeze
tiers.notes: $100 monthly minimum, based on annual agreement.

tiers.name: Residential Breeze Premier
tiers.notes: Terms and minimums apply; published residential minimum is $400/month.

tiers.name: Commercial Breeze
tiers.notes: $200 monthly minimum, based on annual agreement.

pros: Publishes clear per-unit entry pricing and minimums
Built-in accounting is part of the core property-management workflow
Supports multiple property types from one product family
cons: Minimum monthly charges apply even to very small portfolios
Some Premier editions and property types require contacting sales
Several optional services and features carry additional fees

alternatives.name: Buildium
alternatives.description: Property management software for accounting, leasing, maintenance, and resident operations.
alternatives.best_for: Rental managers wanting an alternative all-in-one property platform.

alternatives.name: AppFolio
alternatives.description: Property management platform for leasing, accounting, maintenance, and resident workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Property managers wanting a broader platform with a sales-led buying process.

alternatives.name: Entrata
alternatives.description: Property-management operating system connecting leasing, accounting, resident experience, and maintenance.
alternatives.best_for: Larger multifamily operators needing deeper enterprise workflows.
